environment.description: Quarkus application deployed as a container on EKS (Kubernetes 1.28) in namespace 'payments'. Pod runs with default service account. No NetworkPolicy objects applied to the namespace. Node IMDS is accessible (IMDSv2 enabled but reachable from pod network). Application exposed via AWS ALB Ingress with no additional WAF rules. Cookie SameSite attribute not set by application (defaults to None in older browsers).
